questions.passage: Decades of psychological research, including some of my own studies, have undoubtedly established happiness and meaning as paths to a good life with countless benefits. Yet by limiting ourselves to these two paths, we have put a good life out of reach for too many. There is another way to achieve a good life. It may not be stable or comfortable, but it is exhilarating.
questions.prompt: Why does the author introduce another path to a good life?
options: To deny that happiness and meaning have any benefits.
To argue that every good life must be comfortable.
To declare that psychological research has no value.
To widen the possibilities beyond two beneficial but limiting paths.
questions.promptZh: 作者为什么引入通往美好生活的另一条路？
optionsZh: 否认幸福与意义有任何益处。
主张所有美好生活必须舒适。
宣称心理学研究毫无价值。
在两条有益却可能限制选择的道路之外扩大可能性。
analyses: A countless benefits 明确认可其益处。
B may not be stable or comfortable 保留不舒适的可能。
C 作者以数十年研究为认可两条路的依据，并未否定研究。
D Yet 后批评只限两条路，把好生活推到太多人够不到的地方，因此引入另一条。

evidence.quote: Yet by limiting ourselves to these two paths, we have put a good life out of reach for too many. There is another way to achieve a good life.

vocabulary.meaning: 令人兴奋的；振奋人心的
vocabulary.context: 与稳定、舒适相对，描述另一种生活可能带来的感受
vocabulary.example: The unfamiliar journey was exhausting but exhilarating.

questions.translation: 数十年的心理学研究，包括我自己的一些研究，无疑已确立幸福与意义是通往美好生活的道路，并有无数益处。然而，把自己限制在这两条路上，却让太多人无法企及美好生活。还有另一种实现美好生活的方式。它也许不稳定、不舒适，却令人振奋。

questions.passage: Hermann Hesse, one of the most influential German novelists of the twentieth century and the 1946 Nobel laureate, depicted memorable characters struggling to find a path to the good life in several novels. Narcissus and Goldmund is one of the most popular Hesse novels, which also became a feature film in 2020. Narcissus, one of the title characters, is one of those people who chooses a life of stability. He is smart and popular.
questions.prompt: What does the passage say Hesse depicted in several novels?
questions.promptZh: 原文说黑塞在多部小说中描绘了什么？
options: Only successful scientists conducting psychological trials.
A census of the happiest German cities.
His own verified travel diary without fictional characters.
Memorable characters struggling to find a path to a good life.
optionsZh: 只有进行心理试验的成功科学家。
德国最幸福城市的普查。
没有虚构人物的本人核实旅行日记。
挣扎着寻找好生活道路的令人难忘的人物。
analyses: A 不是仅有科学实验者。
B novels 与人物探索不是城市普查。
C depicted...characters...in several novels 明示小说，不能换成无虚构的日记。
D 保留人物与寻找好生活道路这一主题。作者和人物的身份不可互换。

vocabulary.context: 指小说对人物生活探索的呈现，不是研究者测量真实群体。
vocabulary.example: The novel depicted a family facing an unfamiliar future.

questions.translation: Hermann Hesse 是二十世纪最有影响力的德国小说家之一，也是 1946 年诺贝尔奖得主。他在多部小说中刻画了令人难忘、努力寻找美好生活道路的人物。《Narcissus and Goldmund》是他最受欢迎的小说之一，也在 2020 年被改编成长片。书名人物之一 Narcissus 选择稳定的生活。他聪明，也受欢迎。

evidence.quote: Hermann Hesse, one of the most influential German novelists of the twentieth century and the 1946 Nobel laureate, depicted memorable characters struggling to find a path to the good life in several novels.

questions.prompt: What happened to Narcissus and Goldmund in 2020, according to the passage?
questions.promptZh: 按原文，2020 年《Narcissus and Goldmund》有什么发展？
options: It was first written after Hesse received a Nobel Prize that year.
It became the title of a psychological questionnaire.
It became a feature film.
It was renamed as Kierkegaard's Either/Or.
optionsZh: 在黑塞当年获诺奖后首次写成。
变成心理问卷名称。
被拍成长篇电影。
被改名为克尔凯郭尔的《Either/Or》。
analyses: A 文中黑塞获奖年份是 1946，不是 2020；句子也未说 2020 首次写成。
B 没有问卷化。
C which also became a feature film in 2020 给出改编形式和年份。
D 两部不同作者的作品不能交换标题。

vocabulary.context: 与原来的小说媒介区分，不是电影中的某个小功能。
vocabulary.example: The short story was adapted into a feature film.

questions.prompt: Who is described as 'smart and popular' in this paragraph?
questions.promptZh: 本段把谁描述为 smart and popular？
options: Goldmund, immediately after leaving the monastery.
Narcissus, the title character who chooses stability.
Hesse's interviewer in the Nobel ceremony.
Author B, the retired judge in Either/Or.
optionsZh: 刚离开修道院的歌尔德蒙。
选择稳定生活的书名人物纳尔齐斯。
诺奖典礼采访黑塞的记者。
《Either/Or》中退休法官 Author B。
analyses: A He 接前句 Narcissus，不是之后才展开的 Goldmund。
B Narcissus...chooses a life of stability 是最近先行对象，随后 He 延续其描述。
C 没有这位记者角色。
D Author B 属于下一节另一作品，不能串换。

vocabulary.context: 此处形容人物受欢迎，不是作品销量名次或人格量表分数。

questions.passage: He is happy with his cloistered life and finds his simple, religious life very meaningful. Narcissus becomes a well-respected Aristotelian scholar and the head of his monastery. On the surface, Narcissus is the epitome of success.
questions.prompt: Which roles does Narcissus attain in the novel as described?
questions.promptZh: 按书中小说梗概，纳尔齐斯获得哪些角色？
options: A travelling sculptor and a merchant.
A retired judge and the writer of Either/Or.
A journalist interviewing a Nobel laureate.
A respected Aristotelian scholar and the head of his monastery.
optionsZh: 旅行雕塑家和商人。
退休法官和《Either/Or》作者。
采访诺奖得主的记者。
受尊重的亚里士多德学者和修道院院长。
analyses: A 艺术流浪的路线属于另一人物，不是该句 Narcissus 的职位。
B 退休法官是后文 Author B 的设定。
C 没有记者角色。
D well-respected Aristotelian scholar 与 head of his monastery 明示两项。小说职位不是作者黑塞自己的履历。

vocabulary.context: his monastery 指人物所属宗教机构，head 是负责人，不是建筑顶部。
vocabulary.example: The old monastery contains a library and a quiet courtyard.

questions.translation: 他对隐居修道院的生活很满意，也觉得简单的宗教生活十分有意义。Narcissus 成为受尊敬的亚里士多德学者，以及修道院院长。表面看来，Narcissus 是成功的典范。

evidence.quote: Narcissus becomes a well-respected Aristotelian scholar and the head of his monastery.

questions.passage: Meanwhile, his childhood friend Goldmund yearns for a life outside the cloister and decides to lead the life of a vagabond artist, lacking food, shelter, and stable companions. In the course of his journeying, he witnesses innumerable deaths due to a pandemic. At some point, he questions his decisions: “Did all this make sense? Was it worth experiencing?”
questions.prompt: What does Goldmund's question about whether it was worth experiencing reveal?
questions.promptZh: 歌尔德蒙追问经历是否值得，显示什么？
options: He has already proved that every choice was wrong.
He is reporting a controlled experiment's final result.
He is questioning the value of his own experiences and decisions.
He knows that Narcissus has had exactly the same journey.
optionsZh: 他已证明每个选择都错误。
他在报告对照实验最终结果。
他在反思自己经历和选择的价值。
他知道纳尔齐斯经历了完全相同旅程。
analyses: A 问句不是已经证实一切错误的结论。
B 这是小说人物的自问，不是实验。
C 前面的 he questions his decisions 与 Was it worth experiencing? 支持对自身道路价值的疑问。
D 两条路线不同，没有相同旅程的已知事实。不要把疑问抹平成最终全盘后悔。

vocabulary.context: worth experiencing 询问经历是否值得，不是单问价格或证明最终答案。
vocabulary.example: Was the long discussion worth having?

questions.translation: 与此同时，他童年的朋友 Goldmund 渴望修道院之外的生活，决定过漂泊艺术家的日子，缺少食物、住所和稳定同伴。旅途中，他目睹一场大流行造成的无数死亡。在某个时刻，他质疑自己的决定：“这一切有意义吗？值得经历吗？”

In the course of his journeying, he witnesses innumerable deaths due to a pandemic. At some point, he questions his decisions: “Did all this make sense? Was it worth experiencing?”
